400.description: Session not found or invalid request

account_id.description: The ID of the linked account

score.description: Confidence score of the link between accounts

email.description: Email associated with the linked account

phone.description: Phone number associated with the linked account

first_name.description: First name associated with the linked account

last_name.description: Last name associated with the linked account

username.description: Username associated with the linked account

expected_countries.description: Expected countries declared for the linked account (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes)

match_type.description: Types of matches that linked these accounts. Possible values: browser, device, network, email, phone, username, name, mobile_id, apple_device_check.

lists.description: Lists the linked account belongs to

metadata.description: Additional metadata about the linked account

account_ids.description: List of account IDs associated with this session

true_country_code.description: The true country code of the session

account.description: The account to authenticate. See [Account Object](/api-reference/types/account) for more information.

email.description: The email associated with the account

phone.description: The phone number on file for the account in E.164 format (e.g. +14155550123). Used for multi-accounting phone matching.

first_name.description: The account holder's first name. Combined with last_name for multi-accounting name matching.

last_name.description: The account holder's last name. Combined with first_name for multi-accounting name matching.

username.description: The username associated with the account. Used for multi-accounting username matching.

expected_countries.description: Countries the account is expected to legitimately operate from, as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes (e.g. ["US", "CA"]). A non-empty list replaces the stored list; an empty or omitted list leaves the stored list unchanged.

group.description: Groups must be enabled for the project to use this field. See [Multi Accounting Groups](/integration/advanced/multi-accounting-groups) for more information.

lists.description: Array of list names to add the account to during authentication. Lists will be automatically created if they don't exist. See [Lists](/action/lists) for more information.

session_id.description: The ID of the session to authenticate

accounts_linked.description: Number of accounts linked to this account

linked_accounts.description: List of accounts linked to the authenticated account (only included when accounts_linked=true)

true_country_code.description: The true country code of the session

email.description: The email associated with the account

phone.description: The phone number stored for the account in E.164 format

username.description: The username stored for the account

expected_countries.description: Countries the account is expected to operate from (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes)

group.description: The group associated with the account

num_sessions.description: Number of sessions associated with this account

first_seen.description: Timestamp when the account was first seen

last_seen.description: Timestamp when the account was last seen

countries.description: List of countries associated with this account

1_day.description: Number of unique devices in the last day

7_day.description: Number of unique devices in the last 7 days

1_day.description: Number of unique networks in the last day

7_day.description: Number of unique networks in the last 7 days

domain_type.description: The type of domain. See [Domain Types](/signals-scores/email#domain-types) for details.

email_score.description: Email risk score from -1 (most trustworthy) to 1 (most risky)

trust_signals.description: Array of trust signals detected for this email. See [Trust Flags](/signals-scores/email#trust-flags) for descriptions.

risk_signals.description: Array of risk signals detected for this email. See [Risk Flags](/signals-scores/email#risk-flags) for descriptions.

num_account_from_domain.description: Number of accounts from the same apex domain seen in your project. Capped at 1000. See [Domain Account Velocity](/signals-scores/email#domain-account-velocity) for details.

session_id.description: The ID of the session to evaluate

accounts_linked.description: Number of accounts linked to this session

linked_accounts.description: List of accounts linked to this session (only included when accounts_linked=true)
